title: The War of the Worlds
synopsis: A village writer watches a cylinder fall from the sky and the world he knew burn behind three-legged machines. A retelling of H. G. Wells' classic story of invasion, escape and the smallest rescue of all.
credit: After H. G. Wells (public domain). Original script.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: For centuries we believed the world was ours alone. But across the dark between planets, cool and patient minds were watching Earth, and drawing their plans.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: One evening a streak of green fire fell onto the common outside a quiet village. Ogilvy the astronomer ran toward it. His friend, a writer, followed close behind.

scenes.speaker: ogilvy
scenes.text: This is no meteor. Look at the shape of it. A cylinder, and so hot that the air bends around it. Keep back, my friend.

scenes.speaker: will
scenes.text: Ogilvy, listen. Something is moving inside. A slow scraping, like a lid being turned from within.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The end of the cylinder fell away. Out of the dark reached something grey and glistening, with eyes like wet stone, and it looked at the world it had come to take.

scenes.speaker: ogilvy
scenes.text: They are intelligent. They must be. Wave the white flag. We will show them that we mean peace.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: He walked out alone, holding the white flag high. A flash of heat answered him, and in one breath the common was on fire.

scenes.speaker: wire
scenes.text: Urgent bulletin. More cylinders have fallen across the south. Troops are advancing on the common. All citizens are told to stay indoors.

scenes.speaker: catherine
scenes.text: Tell me the truth. Is it as bad as the wire says? You have not slept, and you will not look at me.

scenes.speaker: will
scenes.text: It is worse, Catherine. Ogilvy is dead. Whatever came out of that cylinder does not want to talk. We leave tonight, before the road is closed.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: But the road was already closed. At dawn the first machines rose over the trees. Towers on three legs, taller than churches, striding across the fields like giants.

scenes.speaker: tripod
scenes.text: We have crossed the void. Your cities are small. Your weapons are small. Surrender, and be spared. Or run, and be counted.

scenes.speaker: gunner
scenes.text: You there! Get down. It sees everything that moves in the open. Down, man, behind the wall, now!

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: They fell in behind a broken wall and watched the machines walk through the smoke. A bright beam swept the street, and the buildings opened like wet paper.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Catherine had reached the coast road before him, and he ran to find her. Behind the hedges the whole county was moving: carts, children, grandmothers, all walking away from the fire.

scenes.speaker: catherine
scenes.text: There is a steamer at the harbour taking women and children. You must come with me, please. Please.

scenes.speaker: will
scenes.text: I will put you on it, I promise. Then I will go back for the others. Walk with me. Keep walking, and do not look behind us.

scenes.speaker: gunner
scenes.text: Walk to the harbour if you like. I say we go under the ground. Tunnels and sewers. We build a new city down there and strike back from the dark.

scenes.speaker: will
scenes.text: Under the ground. With what weapons? They burn whole streets in a breath. They cannot be fought. They can only be outlasted.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: All that night the machines gathered people into their baskets. And where their breath of red smoke fell, a strange red weed crept over the fields and drank the rivers.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: At the harbour the last steamer was leaving. He lifted Catherine across the gap, and the ship pulled out into the fog, and she held up her hand until he lost her.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: He walked back alone through a country that had stopped. No birds, no engines, only the red weed rustling around the ruins, and in the distance one machine standing very still.

scenes.speaker: will
scenes.text: It is not moving. It has not moved all morning. And there is a sound coming from it, a long thin cry, falling and falling.

scenes.speaker: gunner
scenes.text: It is a trap. It has to be a trap. You do not walk up to it. I am telling you, stay back, you do not walk up to that thing.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: But he did walk up to it. The hatch hung open. Inside, the grey creatures lay in their seats, crumpled and still, and the machine around them was only metal.

scenes.speaker: will
scenes.text: Dead. All of them. Not by a gun, and not by any fire of ours. Something smaller than the smallest dust has done this.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The germs of our own world, to which we have been made strong by a million years of sickness. The Martians had crossed the void and had no defence against them at all.

scenes.speaker: catherine
scenes.text: I read the news on the ship. They told us it was over. I did not believe them. I walked from the harbour, and I did not stop.
